survival_formulas.formula: deathChance = 1 / ((1 + medicine * 0.01 * eventMultiplier + troopLevel * 0.02 + additiveBonuses) * (1 + factorBonuses))

survival_formulas.formula: maxBonus = max(0, medicineSkill - 250), capped by max skill 330 => +80 HP
